recommendation: Keep the audit commit. Future PHD examples or vocabulary expansion should be handled in the Device.conformsTo/value-set issue family, not by restoring obsolete Device.specialization text.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification OO issue asking to clarify Device.specialization as a detailed device-function and standards-conformance description, especially for PHD/PoCD 11073 specialization codes and standard version, not as an alternate manufacturer name.
initial_application: Commit b9623f940a applied FHIR-17642 to the then-current source/device/device-spreadsheet.xml by adding the PHD blood pressure specialization and 11073 nomenclature explanation. That spreadsheet source is no longer present in current source, and Jira/OO minutes later recorded FHIR-17642 as applied through the newer FHIR-36154 Device.specialization work.
additional_context: FHIR-36154 reintroduced Device.specialization for R5 and is already audited on the combined branch. Later Published FHIR-39084 renamed Device.specialization to Device.conformsTo and broadened the conformance model; it is already fixed on the combined branch. Current source/fhir.ini keeps migration aliases from Device.specialization to Device.conformsTo, Device is active in the current build, and current Device source, value sets, and examples still represent standards/specification/version conformance including ISO/IEEE 11073 10101 PHD codes.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Reintroducing the old literal Device.specialization wording would conflict with later published decisions; current Device.conformsTo conveys the same implementer-relevant rule in the active model.
